The Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS) invites applications for the following posts for Dr. Sushila Nayar Hospital, Utavali, Dharni (a 50 beded Mother & Child Hospital in Tribal area of Dharni, Melghat) with the prescribed proforma (
Available Here
) along with the certified photocopies of academic and experience certificates should reach to the office of:
The Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS), 442102
latest by 25/02/2026.
Gynaecologist-1
Paediatrician-1
Anaesthesiologist-1
General Duty Medical Officer-1
Required Qualification:
1 to 3: MBBS with NMC recognized Post-graduate Degree/Diploma in concerned subject.
For 4: MBBS/BAMS with 3-5 years experience in a Hospital.
Candidates with previous experience of working in Hospital-Out patient, Inpatient departments and Community Health Services will be preferred.
Salary:
As per Rules of Kasturba Health Society.
Age Limit
: Between 18-38 years for open category/ between 18-43 years for reserved category. Suitable & experienced candidates can be considered for relaxation in age limit. Superannuated person may also be considered upto the age of 65 years for the post 1 to 3.
SECRETARY
Massive Cleanliness Drive Conducted Along Sevagram...
